oneFilter.intro: Before I say yes to anything, or pick what to work on, run it through this:
questions: Does it move D-One toward autonomous? (Client's + contractor's favourite subcontractor · interchangeable humans · Darren out one month at a time.) Or is it just chase-mode?
Is it the current bottleneck? (Growth Wheel.) Or a shiny distraction from the real constraint?
Do I have capacity? I am a basket — rest fills it, output empties it. Am I resting as much as I'm outputting? Am I inside my 20% buffer?
If it's a deal: Is it what we actually want, and do we hold the power seat? The one willing to walk away has the most power.

Is this slot actually free? A blank space is not automatically free — before I say yes, check the board for what else could have gone there (surf, rest, family, focus). Every yes is a no to something else.

parkingLot.text: Week's findings on the marriage — what actually shifted things, and a second angle beyond 'manning up'.
parkingLot.title: 💛 Marriage — the shift (JBay reset + learning her OS)
notes: Pushed through a wall. Went to JBay, did some manning up after moping at home about not getting what I wanted. Came back feeling fuller, stronger, responsible for myself.

Then got what I'd been yearning for — better than it's been in a very long time. Caught me off guard; struggled to accept it. Part of me didn't want to believe it. Happened again. Had to consciously choose to accept it and be grateful.
★ Manning up, making my life rad, taking care of my own needs, and stopping the transactional nice-guy moves definitely played a big role.

Second angle: she's been watching AI-generated steamy short-form romance content before bed and through the night — feeding her mind & body with desire. Something I clearly haven't been doing effectively.
Couples coach + assessment last week exposed it: I didn't have a clear answer to 'What turns her on?' Should not be a hard question — but women run a completely different OS to men.
★ Stop trying to 'talk man' at her expecting she'll finally get it. Learn how HER system communicates instead.
★ Outcome-based action ('a way to get more action') creates an energy block — the system senses it. Get appeasement action, not the real thing. Let go of the outcome.
THE THREE FINDINGS:
1. Man up. Do what makes me happy. Fill my cup and overflow.
2. Find out what actually turns her on and make it part of our life.
3. Let go of the outcome. Love her regardless.
